title: FemTheme Solo #004 · 여 브라질리언 부티 글램·파키스탄브라이덜글램·뱀파이어 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright snowfield with bare trees under a pale sky, a wooden fence of normal height and a cabin with a standard-size door in the distance, bright and evenly lit with crisp defined shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, under hard direct flash lighting, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Pakistani woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, gold-dust eyeshadow, a deep maroon lip, richly detailed bridal makeup, warm brown skin, soft rose-gold hair styled in sleek straight, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted ruby drop, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a silver cube-shaped block, a bronze pyramid-shaped lump, a silver ship's anchor, a copper miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten platinum necklaces. Extremely long oval nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide; a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle, the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape; a full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms; her head looks small on top of her body; not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a long black cape lined in red silk, fastened at her neck and hanging open down her back, leaving the front of her body bare, a micro strapless black satin bandeau reduced to the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and covering only what it must, and a minimal black satin micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
SUBJECT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme gold platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material reflecting the flash in sharp specular glints, the hard light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
